$comment: Connection descriptor. Credentials are deliberately absent: OIC does not
export secrets, and the import wizard prompts for them. Anything that
looks like a secret here is a placeholder to be replaced per environment.
name: New Hire SFTP
description: SFTP landing zone for ATS new-hire extracts, run summaries and rejects.

properties.$comment_hostkey: Pin the fingerprint. Without it the first connection to an impostor host succeeds silently.
properties.$comment_pgp: Set to yes and register the key when the extract carries national identifiers; see docs/runbook.md.

security.$comment: Supplied at import time, never in the archive.
